meta.name: account-research-sales-card
meta.description: 销售增长助手适合销售、市场营销、运营、产品在用户提出“客户为什么不推进”这类问题，需要快速拆解目标、判断重点并形成可执行结果时使用，帮助基于输入材料生成摘要、诊断结论、行动建议和可复用交付物。

copy.tagline: 快速分析客户停滞原因并生成行动建议
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果常需分析客户不推进的原因并制定下一步行动
copy.tagline_en: Quickly analyze why a client is stuck and generate action steps
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you often need to diagnose stalled deals and plan next actions

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

howto.what: 装上后，当你提供客户资料，Claude 会生成摘要、诊断结论、行动建议和可复用交付物，帮你分析客户为什么不推进。
howto.when: 当你提出“客户为什么不推进”这类问题，或需要快速拆解目标、判断重点并形成可执行结果时触发。

say.text: 帮我分析这个客户为什么不推进，资料如下：...
say.note: Claude 会生成摘要和诊断结论。

say.text: 生成一份快速作战卡，针对这个客户。
say.note: Claude 会输出行动建议和交付物。

howto.what_en: When you provide client materials, Claude generates a summary, diagnostic conclusions, action recommendations, and reusable deliverables to help analyze why a client is not moving forward.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you ask questions like "Why isn't the client moving forward?" or need to quickly break down goals, assess priorities, and form actionable results.

say_en.text: Analyze why this client isn't moving forward. Here are the details: ...
say_en.note: Claude will produce a summary and diagnostic conclusions.

say_en.text: Generate a quick battle card for this client.
say_en.note: Claude will output action recommendations and deliverables.
